create_argparser: create an argparse CLI parser with flags for fn, label, compare, omit-baselines, quiet, and fail_if_regression
benchmark_run_and_compare: run benchmarks across cases, compare against stored CSV results, and detect performance regressions
benchmark_main_helper: run a benchmark function with CLI args, dispatching to benchmark_run_and_compare with cases and options
benchmark_main_helper2: run forward and backward benchmarks with optional CUDA graph replay for each benchmark class
pretty_print: print benchmark results as a Markdown-compatible table with units and per-workload columns
